about: FLYER-REPO 2026-11-16: the files of the stand-alone flyer mod (Workshop 3840651516, ld_air_dive.pack) that the main repository shares with the wh3-flyer-dive repository. Both repositories carry these paths at the same relative location and with the same blob bytes; mod/tools/sync_flyer_repo.py keeps them equal. An entry is an exact path or '<dir>/**' (everything under that directory). Files that live only in wh3-flyer-dive (README, .gitignore, .gitattributes, hooks/, .sync/) are listed under flyer_only and never come back to the main repository.
not_shared_build_dependencies: build_air_dive_minimod.py imports db_writer (through installed_db_table and air_dive_rules), which loads the main mod's whole DB writer, unit catalog, validate_mod and their data, plus the RPFM schema file. Measured 2026-11-16 by tracing a real build: 35 tool modules, 7 vanilla caches, 10 portrait images, lore_disasters.lua. Those are main-mod code and content, so they are not shared; the pack is built from a main checkout (README).
